jobs.description:
Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

Welltec as a company is a truly global diverse team with over 60 nationalities in total. At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of 33 colleagues with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. The D&E function also includes electronic and software engineers. In D&E we also work in smaller project groups – Mechanical-, Electrical- and Software Engineers together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary well intervention technologies, ranging from our Well Tractor with more than 20 years of service time to new and innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

Your tasks will include:

• Develop new tools to solve cutting-edge problems.

• Work on technical projects through all development phases.

• Work in teams on development projects with both individual and shared responsibilities.

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies.

• Design reviews guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking.

• 3D mechanical design.

• Plan, prepare and perform practical functional and verification testing of prototypes, tools and systems.

• Apply a structured and systematic approach to troubleshooting and root cause analysis during practical testing and development.

• Troubleshoot both existing solutions and new solutions under development, combining engineering analysis with hands-on testing.

• Provide guidance and input within your specific areas of expertise across the organization.

• Participate in project-related travel when required, including support for testing, troubleshooting, qualification activities and other project needs at Welltec locations, suppliers or customer sites.

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems.

The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology, practical engineering and open-ended challenges. You are comfortable moving between engineering analysis, CAD design and hands-on testing, and you approach technical problems in a structured and systematic way.

In order to perform well in this role, you should have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar background.

• Experience from the energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electromechanical systems, mechatronics, oilfield or similar.

• Possesses relevant deep technical knowledge and is able to apply it broadly with impact.

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects and enjoys broad responsibility.

• Strong hands-on engineering mindset with experience in practical functional testing, verification and systematic troubleshooting.

• Able to translate test observations and failures into root causes, design improvements and clear next actions.

• Agile Project Management skills.

• Knows when to supervise and delegate tasks to maximize efficiency and avoid bottlenecks.

• Experienced CAD user in CATIA or a similar system.

• Willing and able to travel as required to support project activities, testing and technical problem solving.

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

Would you like to enter a creative R&D environment where you participate in developing innovative solutions for people with intimate healthcare needs worldwide? And would you like to play a key part in integrating the systems engineering approach, allowing us to develop even better products? Is your Design control and risk management experience within non-digital medical devices?

Joining our dynamic department, you can look forward to becoming part of a great work environment where you will work alongside knowledgeable specialists and project managers.

About the role

We are looking for Systems Engineers for 1 permanent position and 1 12-months maternity cover position to strengthen our combined Systems & Test Engineering team in Product Development at Coloplast. The role supports ongoing development by driving systems engineering and design control execution in close collaboration with R&D specialists, Test Engineering, QA, Scientific Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management.

Your responsibilities:

•    Drive and support design control and product risk management activities in development projects.

•    Translate stakeholders into clear, high-quality system and subsystem requirements with end-to-end traceability.

•    Own and contribute to systems engineering documentation, including design input/output, product description, and risk documentation.

•    Support design verification and validation planning and execution in close collaboration with Test Engineering.

•    Participate in design reviews, change control, and impact assessments.

•    Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and quality requirements (e.g. MDR, FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).

•    Collaborate closely with cross-functional project teams to support timely project execution.

Your background

•    Degree in engineering or a similar technical discipline.

•    Experience with systems engineering and design control in a regulated environment required for permanent position (medical devices are an advantage).

•    Knowledge of risk management, requirements engineering, and traceability.

•    Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, Test, Quality, and Regulatory stakeholders.

•    Strong analytical and communication skills.

•    Experience with Polarion or similar ALM tools is an advantage.

What we offer

A 12-months temporary position and a permanent position in a collaborative and learning environment with strong focus on quality, high professional standards, good sparring and learning. You will get real responsibility from the start and the opportunity to build strong capability in systems engineering and regulated product development. You will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues in Systems Engineering, Test Engineering, and Product Development.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Simon Gadving Schmidt, Head of CC & BC Systems and Test Engineering dksgs@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. These positions will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

A Snapshot of Your Day

This Specialist Professional role is a critical replacement to ensure business continuity within the Power and Grid Management team. The position is essential for maintaining agreed-upon delivery schedules and upholding the quality standards for our power plant control systems. To achieve these objectives, the role focuses on three core areas: advanced test strategy and planning, comprehensive test execution and automation, and rigorous defect management and analysis. These activities ensure that our digital products and solutions for the energy sector are robust, reliable, and meet all technical specifications before deployment. Given the focus on complex system verification, the ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert with extensive experience in verification engineering. This includes proven proficiency in test automation, scripting languages, and a deep understanding of the engineering design process, coupled with the ability to manage large projects and mentor junior professionals.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Analyze complex technical requirements and system designs for power and grid management solutions to define comprehensive verification strategies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust test plans, test cases, and test procedures for new and existing product features.

• Act as a subject matter expert, managing large-scale test projects and processes with limited oversight.

• Coach, review, and delegate test development work to lower-level professionals, ensuring adherence to quality standards.

• Execute advanced manual and automated tests to validate functional requirements, benchmark system performance, and ensure product reliability.

• Develop, implement, and maintain sophisticated test automation frameworks and scripts using Python, Tcl, or other relevant languages.

• Establish and manage complex test environments, including system simulations and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups.

• Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline to enhance development workflow efficiency and feedback cycles.

• Identify, document, and meticulously track software defects and system anomalies through to resolution using workflow management tools.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for difficult and complex problems, collaborating with development teams to find effective solutions.

• Generate detailed test summary reports and quality metrics to communicate findings and system readiness to stakeholders.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Extensive experience, around 10 years, as a subject matter expert in verification engineering, software testing, or a similar role.

• Proven experience managing complex test projects or processes and mentoring other professionals.

• Demonstrated expertise in test automation, scripting, and testing complex software and hardware systems.

• Technical expertise in test automation, Python programming, scripting, Linux environments, simulations, and firmware development to support the design, testing, automation, and optimization of reliable and high‑quality technology solutions.

• Ability to apply Generative AI tools to improve test design, accelerate test procedure creation, enhance automation development, and increase overall testing efficiency and coverage.

• Expertise in quality and process management, including test planning, quality assurance, engineering design processes, and workflow management to ensure efficient execution, high‑quality deliverables, and continuous improvement across engineering and development activities.

• Strong behavioral abilities, including troubleshooting and problem‑solving, analytical thinking, and influencing skills to support effective decision-making, stakeholder engagement, and the successful resolution of complex challenges.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• Work-life balance: Flexible working time

• Flexible mobile working policy (hybrid)

• Local benefits such as meal allowance, flexible plan and much more

• Self-driven development framework with insights and resources to develop and grow on technical and soft skills. Continuous learning

• International and cross Business Units

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Do you want to turn complex information security risks into decisions and actions that protect the business and enable its strategic ambitions? At COWI, you will work at the intersection of cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business operations, technology, and digital transformation. You will play a central role in identifying the information security risks that matter most and ensuring they lead to clear ownership, informed decisions, and effective risk reduction.

At COWI, we create sustainable solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and generations to come. Our experts work across infrastructure, energy, water, environment, architecture, and buildings, delivering projects that shape societies and support critical services around the world.

As a trusted advisor to clients and partners, information security is an essential part of how we deliver projects, protect information, manage risk, and maintain trust. Our increasing use of digital platforms, data, artificial intelligence, and software-based delivery models creates new opportunities, but also increases our exposure to cybersecurity, regulatory, supply-chain, and delivery risks.

Your role, responsibilities, and team

COWI is strengthening its approach to information security risk management as part of a broader development of Information Security and Enterprise Risk Management across the Group.

Our ambition is to identify and understand the most important information security risks facing COWI, enable informed management decisions, drive effective risk treatment, and provide transparency and assurance to Executive Management and the Board.

This role has been established to help turn that ambition into practice.

As Senior Information Security Risk Specialist, you will be responsible for driving the information security risk management process across COWI. You will develop a consolidated and business-relevant risk picture, facilitate complex risk assessments, challenge assumptions, and translate material risks into decision-ready treatment options.

An important part of the role is ensuring that significant risks are not simply recorded in a risk register. You will help transform prioritized risks into clearly defined initiatives and projects, with accountable business owners, realistic delivery plans, measurable outcomes, and transparent reporting.

You will be part of the Group CISO and the ERM function, and you will work closely with IT, Legal, Procurement, Process & Quality, Transformation Office, and Business Lines, incl. operational risk owners across all of these.

Your primary responsibilities will include

• Leading the identification, analysis, evaluation and prioritization of information security risks across COWI’s business operations, projects, digital solutions, information assets, and third-party dependencies.

• Translating technical, regulatory and operational security issues into clear business-risk scenarios, including credible causes, consequences, existing controls, risk exposure and treatment options.

• Facilitating strategic risk assessments and cross-functional risk workshops with senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, and accountable risk owners.

• Preparing decision-ready risk analysis and reporting for the Group CISO, Executive Management, the ERM Committee, the Audit Committee, and the Board of Directors.

• Developing risk treatment proposals and project charters for prioritized risks, including proposed scope, ownership, governance, outcomes, dependencies, resource requirements, milestones and measures of risk reduction.

• Supporting risk owners in defining practical key risk indicators, treatment progress measures and evidence that demonstrate whether risk exposure is being reduced.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You are a proactive and accountable driver who identifies what needs to happen, aligns stakeholders, and delivers results—not just recommendations. Structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, you thrive in fast-paced environments, manage diverse requests effectively, and stay focused on the priorities that create the biggest impact. You build trust across teams, challenge yourself constructively, and drive decisions when security requirements must be met. At the same time, you are curious and committed to continuous learning, staying ahead of threats, standards, and best practices while turning knowledge into practical improvements.

On top of that, you will have:

• Strong experience with information security, governance and risk management.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex topics into clear, actionable guidance.

• Strong analytical skills, a structured approach, and the ability to drive multiple parallel initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence and create momentum

• Educational background?

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it’s a part of our values and because it’s simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Can you own the platform and pipelines that EIVA’s software is built on?

EIVA is an equipment and software engineering company delivering solutions to the international maritime industry. Our customers operate within renewable energy, oil & gas exploration, seabed-to-surface construction and hydrographic surveying – often in demanding environments where timing, precision and safety margins matter.

You do not need to know the subsea domain to apply. Here, your product is the software itself, and your users are the other engineering teams who build and ship on the platform you own. What matters is curiosity – the ability to ask the right questions and translate what you hear into good technical decisions – and a collaborative, team-first mindset.

The position is based at EIVA’s Danish office in Stilling (just one minute from the E45, approximately 15 minutes from Aarhus by car and easily accessible by bus).

What's involved?

As Tech Lead – Infrastructure, you'll own the platform, pipelines and infrastructure that our NaviSuite software is built on.

Around 80% of the role is hands-on: working directly in the team's technical domains – platform, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and tooling. The rest is technical leadership – owning architecture within the Infrastructure team, making the final call on anything inside the team's decision domain, and knowing when a question needs to go further, to our architects or to alignment with other teams. You'll also help keep that decision domain itself well defined: what the team can decide on its own, and where it needs external alignment.

There could be occasional travel – around one to two short trips a year.

Your responsibilities…

• Doing hands-on development and engineering work across the team's core technical domains – platform, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and internal tooling (around 80% of the role)

• Making the final technical decisions within the team's decision domain, and helping define where that domain's boundaries sit versus where the team needs external alignment

• Securing technical quality in the team – code and infrastructure-as-code review, best practices, testing and automation standards

• Owning architecture in the team – ensuring platform and pipeline work aligns with EIVA's overall architecture, and explaining the interdependencies to the team

• Participating in refinement, securing that features, stories and tasks describe architectural dependencies, feasibility, quality requirements and operational aspects such as reliability, security, cost and developer experience

• Cross team alignment – representing the Infrastructure team's technical position and making sure its work fits with adjacent work elsewhere in the organisation

• Driving clarification with architects on technical questions that sit outside the team's decision domain

Also part of the role…

• Providing technical mentoring and sparring for the team's engineers

• Supporting the other development teams as users of the platform – helping with adoption, guidance and acting on their feedback

• Taking operational responsibility for the platform and pipelines

• Keeping the team's technical practices current – seeking out training, evaluating new tooling and sharing that knowledge internally

• Maintaining technical documentation for the platform, pipelines and environments

• Giving technical input to hiring and onboarding new engineers on the team

• Giving technical input to estimation and planning together with the Team Manager/Product Owner

The ideal candidate…

• Has a background in software engineering or computer science

• Has hands-on experience building and maintaining platforms, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and internal tooling

• Has experience managing complex DevOps systems and workflows, and is comfortable making final technical calls within a defined decision domain

• Is familiar with tools such as Git/GitHub, artifact storage, Ansible and Terraform

• Has a collaborative mindset – comfortable gathering feedback from stakeholders across teams and using it to design clean, well-reasoned solutions

• Is a team player who's good at knowledge-sharing and educating peers, and takes proactive ownership of their domain

• It's a bonus if you also have experience with licence management systems, but not a requirement.

Joining the EIVA crew

At EIVA, you'll join a team that values openness, informality and collaboration – while working with high-end, innovative technology in an inspiring environment. We appreciate personal responsibility and proactivity, and there is room to make your mark if you spot new opportunities. Work-life balance matters to us and is reflected in the 15th, 20th and even 25th work anniversaries commonly celebrated at EIVA. We offer…

• A pension scheme and health insurance

• A canteen that no one leaves hungry

• An active social calendar

Ready to dive in?

If this sounds like your kind of ownership, we'd love to hear from you. In your application, please tell us about a DevOps solution you've built that you're most proud of.

We review applications and hold interviews on a rolling basis until we find the right person, so don't wait for a deadline to apply. We're aiming for a start by 1 November.

For more information, please contact Joseph Sondergaard Daley, Manager, Autonomy Services – Software Development, at jsd@eiva.com.

Learn more about EIVA

ROLE DESCRIPTION

INVISIO is looking for a commercially minded and pragmatic Corporate Legal Counsel to support its global business. This is a broad legal generalist role with a strong commercial focus, where you will work closely with the business and provide legal support across a wide range of matters, with particular emphasis on international contracts, tenders, customer projects and other commercial legal matters.

As Corporate Legal Counsel, you will become part of a small legal team together with Signe Karstoft, Legal Director, to whom you will report. The role is based at INVISIO’s headquarters in Hvidovre, and the legal function is organisationally anchored within INVISIO’s Sales & Program function, which consists of approximately 50 employees globally, including around 25-30 in Denmark. You will primarily support the global sales organisation and work closely with colleagues across the business. Much of your work will involve large and complex customer contracts, tenders and projects.

You will provide legal support across INVISIO’s international business, including in relation to US contracts, such as contracts within the defence sector, and support sales teams across Europe and other markets. You will also support INVISIO in connection with major public tenders, including tenders involving ministries and defence organisations, providing legal support on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

As a technology company, intellectual property is an important part of INVISIO’s business. While dedicated specialists handle areas such as patents, you may also advise on IP-related matters as part of the broader commercial legal support. Experience with IP or from a technology or other IP-intensive business would therefore be an advantage.

In addition to the day-to-day legal support, you will contribute to developing and improving the way Legal supports the business. This includes driving legal improvement initiatives, maintaining and developing contract templates and legal guidelines, and conducting workshops and awareness activities for the business.

The role is highly international and outward-facing, with significant interaction with customers and stakeholders at all levels. You will have opportunities to join customer visits and negotiate contracts abroad, as well as participate in trade fairs in Denmark, Europe and the US.

The role is expected to involve approximately 25 travel days per year.

As INVISIO continues to grow rapidly, you will work in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and no two days are the same.

AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

INVISIO is looking for an independent and commercially minded lawyer who takes ownership and enjoys working closely with customers and colleagues across the organisation. Your key responsibilities will include:

Commercial contracts and negotiations:

• 
Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including large international sales contracts, non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent, consulting agreements, tender-related contracts and distribution agreements.

• 
Take an active role in customer dialogue and contract negotiations and provide commercially focused legal advice, working closely with relevant stakeholders to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives.

• 
Provide pragmatic legal advice on contractual and other commercial matters arising in the day-to-day business.

**

Tenders and customer projects:**

• 
Provide legal support in connection with major public tenders, including reviewing tender documentation and advising on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

• 
Advise on legal and contractual aspects of tender structures, including which INVISIO entity should participate and any related intercompany arrangements.

• 
Support and, where relevant, take a coordinating role in customer projects and other commercial initiatives, including advising on contractual set-ups, priorities and how existing solutions can be applied in different markets etc.

**

IP and export control:**

• Ad hoc Advise on IP and export control matters, including IP considerations in commercial agreements and questions relating to export restrictions and requirements in connection with international sales and customer projects.

**

Legal development and business support:**

• 
Develop, maintain and improve contract templates, legal guidelines and other tools.

• 
Drive legal improvement initiatives and conduct workshops and legal awareness activities for the business, for example in relation to NDA’s.

• 
Provide ad hoc legal advice and support across INVISIO as required.

REPORTING AND TITLE

Reporting to: Signe Karstoft, Legal Director.

Title: Corporate Legal Counsel.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Education: You hold a master’s degree in law (cand.jur. or cand.merc.jur.).

Work experience: You have approximately 3-6 years of relevant legal experience from an in-house role, for example in a technology or software company or another larger international industrial company.

Legal areas of specialisation: You have strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements and are comfortable handling contractual matters independently. You also have experience supporting tender processes and advising on the legal and contractual matters that arise in this context.

In addition, you have a broad legal profile and are able to navigate a varied range of legal matters. Experience with IP-related matters, particularly from a technology or other IP-intensive business, would be an advantage. Knowledge of export control would also be beneficial.

Commercial: You have a strong commercial mindset and understand how legal advice fits into the broader business context.

You have experience working directly with customers and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. You are able to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives and provide pragmatic, solution-oriented advice.

Language skills: You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and verbal.

PERSONAL CAPABILITIES

Independent & proactive: You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities and proactively drive matters forward.

Outgoing & interpersonal: You are outgoing and enjoy interacting with people with different backgrounds and at all levels, both internally and externally. You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable engaging with customers, colleagues and senior management.

Analytical & pragmatic: You have strong analytical skills and are able to understand complex legal and commercial matters while maintaining a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

Structured & able to prioritise: You work in a structured manner, maintain a good overview of your responsibilities and are able to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment where new and urgent matters frequently arise. You remain calm and focused when priorities change or deadlines are tight.

Stakeholder management & collaboration: You build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and organisational levels. You are a team-oriented colleague who contributes to a strong sense of teamwork across the organisation and is able to influence stakeholders in a constructive manner.

Positive & constructive: You have a professional approach to your work and interact with others with maturity and integrity. You bring positive energy, are resilient when challenges arise and remain constructive in a busy environment.

INVISIO’S VALUE PROPOSITION TO YOU

INVISIO is a rapidly growing company with ambitious growth targets. The company achieves these ambitions through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts will be important to INVISIO’s continued success, and by joining the company, you will become part of an international headquarter with an informal working environment.

INVISIO offers a wide range of professional and social employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

ABOUT INVISIO

INVISIO is a global leader in communications technology for professionals working in mission-critical environments. Established in Denmark in 1999, the company develops and markets advanced, integrated communication systems for defence and public safety professionals, helping users communicate clearly and safely in demanding environments.

INVISIO’s modular and scalable portfolio includes headsets, control units, intercom systems, hubs and software designed to work together across dismounted, vehicle-based and command operations. The solutions are marketed under the INVISIO and Racal Acoustics brands.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, INVISIO has an international presence across Europe, North America and Asia. The company has approximately 330 employees globally, including around 215 in Denmark, and is growing rapidly. INVISIO is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (Large Cap).

INVISIO is characterised by a strong focus on innovation, close customer collaboration and an international working environment. Its core values are Passion, Innovation, Teamwork and Customer First.

You can learn more about INVISIO here: www.invisio.com.

APPLICATION AND CONTACT

If you believe this position is a good fit for you, we look forward to receiving your application. Please attach your CV and any relevant documentation. Should you have any questions regarding the position, please don’t hesitate to contact Camilla Krogh at (+45 51261264) or Mikkel Falkenberg at (+45 29993065) from the team at RESOLVA.

Job Description

Would you like to use your property management experience to help develop solutions that create real value? As a Property Manager at Netcompany, you will work with technical teams and customers to turn real-life experience into solutions that improve property management through a data driven approach that ensure the right usage of AI and digital capabilities.

Responsibilities

Netcompany is looking for a Property Manager to take a key role in the continued development of our property management solutions. The role is for an experienced, operational property manager who knows the reality of managing properties day to day and can use that experience to help shape better digital solutions. You will bring hands-on knowledge of property management into the product development process and work closely with technical and refinement teams to ensure that solutions reflect real-life processes, challenges and user needs. You will also contribute to customer dialogue, where your practical experience helps create credibility and a strong understanding of how the product can support customers in their daily work.

A significant part of the role involves leveraging your property management experience in product improvements, customer insight and relevant market activities. You will participate in customer meetings, support pre-sales activities and contribute to business development through market dialogue and feedback from existing and potential customers. This is not a sales role; your contribution is your professional expertise and ability to understand the customer's operational reality, ask the right questions and help connect their needs with the capabilities of the product.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Ensuring the product delivers value, automation potential and efficiency across the property management value chain

• Working closely with the technical team and refinement team on product development

• Supporting business development and sales activities through market dialogue, customer feedback and pre-sales activities

• Participating in customer meetings and other client-facing activities

• Building trust and credibility in customer dialogues

About you

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have solid operational experience working as a property manager

• Contribute with operational experience across a property portfolio, including the full complexity of Danish regulatory requirements (eg.  cost control rent 'OMK', free market rent, taxes, duties and rates, operational budgets)

• Have experience across residential, commercial and mixed properties including the customer reporting requirements a property manager faces

• Have experience as a power user or super user of a property management software system

Head of Engineering to join a technology-driven intelligence company serving the renewable energy industry

Please note: We do not offer relocation or sponsorship for this position, and only candidates able to work on location will be considered

Want to lead a small team of developers and data scientists while staying close to the code? Want real ownership of an established platform inside a growing 20-person startup? Want to enable a greener future by helping major energy companies decide where to invest in renewable energy?

Then this might be your next role

Join Aegir Insights and get a unique opportunity to join a workplace where you can make a difference every day, whilst being part of a young, agile and fast-paced company.

We are accelerating the transition towards renewable energy sources worldwide by providing products that enable developers, investors, consultancies, suppliers, and governments across onshore wind, offshore wind, solar, storage and data centers to make smarter decisions, faster.

As Head of Engineering, you will own the platform behind our products and build the engineering team that runs it.

The platform combines curated data on more than 100,000 renewable energy projects, geospatial analytics, and financial models

Built on a stack of

React/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, MongoDB, AWS, and Kubernetes.

The role spans technical direction, hands-on engineering, team building, delivery, and building the engineering function in Copenhagen

You will come in at a critical time in our growth and take the lead of a small team of 5 technical profiles ranging from Software developers to data scientists

You report to the founders and work closely with our commercial team and our in-house renewable energy experts.

This is not a management-only role. It is a hands-on engineering leadership role for someone equally comfortable designing and implementing a Python service, reviewing a data model, debugging a production issue, hiring a senior engineer, and explaining an architecture decision to the board.

Your key tasks will be to

• Own the technical direction of the platform: architecture, data foundations, security, reliability and build-versus-buy decisions

• Remain hands-on: design, build and review production code, particularly across our Python/FastAPI backend, APIs, data services and platform infrastructure

• Own systems end-to-end: be willing to trace a problem from React/TypeScript through APIs and data models to MongoDB, AWS/Kubernetes and external services, and fix it at the appropriate layer

• Translate product priorities set with the founders and commercial team into a technical roadmap and delivery plan

• Raise the engineering bar: establish pragmatic patterns for architecture, testing, APIs, code review, deployment, observability and documentation - and demonstrate those standards through your own engineering work

• Lay the foundation for secure multi-tenant SaaS, including authentication, authorization and permission-aware workflows

• Own the technical foundations for AI-native products and workflows, including our MCP infrastructure and secure programmatic access to Aegir's data, analytics and financial models

During the first 6–12 months, we expect the role to remain about 50-60% hands-on while you learn the platform, establish the technical direction, and make a plan for how to grow the department.

We imagine that you

• Have an educational background in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical engineering experience

• Bring experience from similar software engineering roles

• With experience in Python, APIs, data-intensive systems, and cloud architecture, while being comfortable working across a modern React/TypeScript stack

• Ideally with experience leading engineers or engineering teams, while remaining hands-on in recent roles

• Fluent english

Extra point if you have

• Have improved a live, complex platform without reaching for a ground-up rewrite

• Have personally designed, built and operated production backend systems and APIs, including data models, authentication/authorisation, asynchronous workloads and integrations between systems

• Have experience designing data-intensive applications, analytical systems or data pipelines, and making pragmatic decisions about performance, cost and maintainability

• Experience with geospatial systems, financial modelling or the energy sector is an advantage Comfortable using modern AI coding tools as part of everyday engineering and interested in how AI changes software development itself - not just in adding LLM features to products

Working at Aegir Insights

We offer a respectful, diverse, and international working environment (our company language is English).

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Cognitive Computational Neuroscience and Human Movement Perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology invites applications for a postdoctoral position in Cognitive Computational Neuroscience and Human Movement Perception by 1 March 2027 or after agreement.

  The position is a fixed-term position for 30 months/2.5 years.
 
 Introduction
 The postdoc will be part of a project entitled "Mapping Experience of Action: Redefining Theories of Consciousness" funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. The project is headed by Professor Thor Grünbaum and Associate Professor in Cognitive Psychology Mark Schram Christensen Department of Psychology, University of Copenhagen.

  This interdisciplinary project develops a novel scientific approach to the study of consciousness by investigating conscious experiences of movement. Combining psychophysical experiments, computational modelling, and philosophical analysis, it examines how bodily and neural signals contribute to movement awareness. The project aims to advance our understanding of consciousness and critically evaluate leading neuroscientific theories of conscious experience.

  Applicants are asked to develop a short project description for the postdoc. It is critical that applicants are able to situate their project and research plan within the framework of the overall project. It is a requirement that applicants request from Associate Professor Mark Schram Christensen (markc@psy.ku.dk) the original project proposal prior to submitting the application.

  Candidates with various background may be considered for the position. Examples of relevant backgrounds are PhDs in cognitive (neuro)science, computational neuroscience, cognitive modelling, biomedical engineering, sports science with a focus on behavioural neuroscience, or similar. The candidates are expected to have strong skills in cognitive modelling, experimental design, data handling and data analysis documented in relevant scientific publications.

  The postdoc will be working in close collaboration with the other project members which has academic backgrounds in cognitive neuroscience and philosophy, and student assistants with background in Cognitive Data Science.  The position will be placed in the Cognition, Intention and Action research group, part of the Section for Cognition and Brain Sciences, Department of Psychology.  It is expected that the successful candidate will be present, part of the team, and take part in the activities in the Lab on a daily basis.
 
 Duties and Responsibilities
 The primary focus of the postdoctoral position will be on research within the main project. However, a certain amount of teaching obligations may be required. Additional tasks beyond research and teaching may also be considered, but to a limited extent. The university will determine the final scope of the various responsibilities, and the emphasis may vary over time.
 
 Qualification Requirements 
 Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher requires research qualifications at a level at least equivalent to those obtained through the satisfactory completion of a PhD programme within the relevant field.

  Strong skills in data handling and analysis are crucial, and experience with cognitive/computational modelling within human behavioural science or neuroscience is key to the content of the project. 

  You can find further information about the qualification requirements for postdoctoral positions here: Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (In Danish only).

  You can also find further information about the postdoctoral position on our English webpage on career paths for early‑career researchers at the University of Copenhagen: Career at The University of Copenhagen.
 
 Strategy of the Faculty of the Social Sciences
 The Department of Psychology is part of the Faculty of the Social Sciences. The faculty is a successful academic community that strives to put knowledge into action by:

  Engaging partners in the co-creation of knowledge, learning and social change.

  Empowering our students to become reflective and responsible citizens who have the vision, the knowledge and the competences to change society for the better.

  Energising global, European and Danish communities of knowledge by innovating research methodologies and by research findings with impact.

  For more on the faculty’s strategy, please see: Strategy for the Faculty of Social Science.
 
 Assessment Criteria
 Applicants will primarily be assessed in relation to their research qualifications, including their publications, ability to conduct independent research and participate in research collaborations, and their experience of research management. In addition, the applicant’s research plan and research potential will be assessed in relation to the overall project described above.

  Teaching qualifications are not a requirement.
 
 Application
 Please submit your application online. To apply, please click on the “Apply now” icon at the bottom of this page. The application must be written in English, and include the following attachments in PDF or Word format:

   	
• CV (max. 3 pages) 	
• Cover letter including the preferred starting date (max. 1 page) 	
• Documentation of qualifications (exam certificates and PhD diploma) 	
• Complete publication list (attached publications must be marked with an asterisk). The list must be structured systematically and divided into the following categories: 	 		
• Peer-reviewed publications: 		
• Monographs and anthologies 		
• Articles in journals 		
• Book chapters/anthology contributions, etc. 		
• Non-peer-reviewed publications: 		
• Publications disseminating research findings, etc.
 		  	 	 	
• You can attach a maximum of 3 publications. The publication dates must be clearly marked on the list. The selected publications must be uploaded as attachments and numbered 1-3.
 	  	
• A short project description (max. 2 pages). 	 		
• The description should outline your ideas for the postdoc project situated in the state-of-the-art research in the field of the project. It should include your proposals for specific types of experimental and modelling approaches that you envision to contribute with to the project. The description must not exceed 2 standard pages, corresponding to approx. 4,800 characters (including title, punctuation, figures, footnotes and references, but excluding bibliography). A substantial breach of this will result in the application being excluded from consideration.
 		  	 	 	
• Research plan (max. 2 pages) 	 		
• The plan should include a brief account of previous research, current research projects, and a forward-looking outline of planned research contribution over the coming years. This may include specific references to the project proposals funded by Independent Research Foundation Denmark, and how the candidate expect to contribute to the project at large. 	 	   
 Salary and Terms of Employment
 Terms of appointment and salary will be in accordance with an agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). The salary range for postdoctoral positions starts at DKK 39,000/approximately EUR 5,100 + an 18.07 % pension contribution. It is possible to negotiate salary supplements on an annual basis.
 
 Recruitment Process
 After the application deadline, the Head of Department will consider advice from the appointment committee and select applicants for assessment. All applicants will be notified whether they have been shortlisted. The Head of Department will set up an expert assessment committee to assess the shortlisted applications. The selected applicants will be informed who is serving on the committee. Each shortlisted applicant will be offered the opportunity to comment on the committee’s assessment before the appointment is announced.

  You can find further information on our recruitment process at: Recruitment process.
 
 International Applicant?
 The University of Copenhagen offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including support before and during your relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about our services at: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen.
 
 An Equal Opportunity Workplace
 The University of Copenhagen is committed in its pursuit of academic excellence to equality of opportunity and to creating an inclusive working environment and therefore encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, ethnicity etc. To learn more about our diverse workplace and our participation in the HRS4R HR Excellence in Research, please visit HR Excellence in Research.
 
 Contact Information
 For additional information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Mark Schram Christensen at email markc@psy.ku.dk or phone +45-3532 2448.

  For more Information about the recruitment process, please contact HR South at hr-soendre@adm.ku.dk. Please refer to ID number: 211-2675/26-2I

  The application deadline is 1 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

  Any applications or additional material submitted after the deadline will not be considered. However, changes may be made to the submitted application right up until the deadline.

Team leadership

Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

What is needed to succeed

Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• 
A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• 
Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• 
Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• 
Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• 
Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• 
Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• 
Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• 
Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• 
Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• 
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• 
A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

We hope to see that you are:

• 
A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• 
A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• 
Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• 
Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• 
An inspiring people leader and coach.

• 
A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• 
Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• 
Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• 
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• 
Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

Your new team

You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

Additional information

• Global Career Band: 4A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

About Us

At Teton, we are redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology. Facing a global nursing shortage, our solutions offer vital support to overburdened health systems. With thousands of patient rooms across 4 countries already benefiting from our technology, we are aiming to expand to much more. We distinguish ourselves by focusing relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, rapidly deploying solutions that make a real difference.

We require a physical presence in our office in Copenhagen, Denmark. We believe this enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles to build an impactful product that users love to use.

The Job

Every patient room we deploy into puts another device on infrastructure we don't control, in a building we can't easily visit, running software that has to keep working. We're looking for an Engineer to own that problem: the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that let us ship to thousands of edge devices confidently and understand what they're doing once they're out there.

In this role, you will focus on the following areas of interest:

• 
Fleet Management: Build and run the systems that provision, monitor, and manage our devices in the field, from first boot in a hospital room to end of life.

• 
OTA & Release Engineering: Own how software gets onto devices: staged rollouts, health checks, automatic rollback, and the confidence that a bad release won't take down a ward.

• 
Observability: Design the telemetry, logging, and alerting that tell us a device is degrading before a nurse notices. Make remote debugging possible so we don't fly to fix things.

• 
Device Bring-Up & Debugging: Work with our hardware and firmware teams on new hardware revisions, reproduce field issues on the bench, and get to the bottom of problems that span kernel, driver, network, and application.

• 
Infrastructure & Tooling: Build the CI/CD, image builds, and internal tools that let the whole engineering team ship to hardware quickly and safely.

• 
Documentation: Maintain clear and detailed documentation of your work to ensure easy collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.

Qualifications:

• 
Solid experience running Linux systems in production: ideally embedded or edge Linux, not just cloud VMs.

• 
Proficiency in Rust and/or Javascript/Typescript and/or Python

• 
Experience with device fleets at scale: provisioning, OTA update mechanisms (Mender, RAUC, balena, or something you built yourself), and remote access to constrained devices.

• 
Familiarity with Linux internals: systemd, kernel modules, device tree, networking stack, containers.

• 
Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar) and designing what to measure, not just wiring up dashboards.

• 
Comfortable with hardware debugging: serial consoles, working alongside hardware engineers

• 
Understanding of communication protocols and how devices talk to each other and to us: I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, MQTT.

• 
Pragmatism about networks you don't control: restrictive hospital IT, VLANs, proxies, flaky Wi-Fi, and long offline periods.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• 
Experience with the NVIDIA Jetson platform and Linux for Tegra is a big plus.

• 
Experience with Yocto, Debian packaging, or custom image builds is a plus.

• 
Experience in the medical device or healthcare technology field is a plus.

What We Offer

• 
Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

• 
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• 
A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

• 
A role where you can make a significant impact on healthcare delivery.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

Do you want to influence how one of Europe's leading pharmaceutical companies leverages technology to create competitive advantage? As IT Business Partner for Pharma Trade, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, shaping strategic priorities and using digital innovation to enable greater growth, efficiency, and scalability

About the job

You will work closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders across Pharma Trade to understand business strategy, commercial priorities, operational challenges, and digital opportunities. You will shape demand and identify how technology can improve decision-making, gross margin, operational scalability, process efficiency, and execution across the Pharma Trade value chain.

You will play a central role in developing and maintaining the technology roadmap for Pharma Trade. This includes connecting needs and opportunities across Business Development, Product Supply, Portfolio Management, Hospital and Tender Management, Regulatory, Sales, and other relevant functions.

Working closely with the Head of Pharma Trade Solutions, Product Owner, delivery teams, and shared IT functions, you will ensure that demand is clearly understood, prioritized, qualified, and prepared for successful delivery. You will help move Pharma Trade towards a coherent, scalable, and value-driven digital landscape.

Your focus will not only be on identifying new initiatives, but also on ensuring that technology investments lead to measurable business outcomes and support the long-term transformation of Pharma Trade.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Act as the primary strategic IT partner and point of contact for new technology demand across Pharma Trade

• Build and maintain a consolidated, value-based technology roadmap for Pharma Trade in close collaboration with business leadership and the Pharma Trade Solutions team

• Develop a deep understanding of Pharma Trade’s end-to-end value chain, business processes, decision points, data needs, and application landscape

• Identify, assess, and develop digital opportunities that can improve gross margin, commercial decision-making, scalability, time-to-market, supply visibility, and operational efficiency

• Ensure that initiatives are prioritized across the entire Pharma Trade domain rather than optimized for individual functions or markets

• Challenge business demand constructively and distinguish between underlying business problems, requested features, and appropriate technology solutions

• Secure clear business ownership of business cases, benefits, process decisions, data, adoption, and value realization

• Coordinate early involvement from Product Owners, Solution Architecture, Data & Analytics, Integration, Cyber Security, Compliance, and other shared IT functions

Who are you?

You are a senior, business-oriented IT professional who combines strong stakeholder management with a structured and analytical approach to technology demand and business value.

You understand both business priorities and IT delivery realities. You are comfortable engaging with senior leaders, but you also have enough technology understanding to challenge, shape, and qualify ideas before they become projects.

You bring:

• Experience in IT business partnering, IT strategy, digital transformation, technology consulting, product ownership, or a similar cross-functional IT role

• Experience from life sciences is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Good understanding of enterprise IT, business applications, architecture, integrations, software delivery, and implementation processes

• Understanding of commercial and operational processes such as business development, product and portfolio management, sourcing and supply planning, pricing, forecasting, and allocation

• Experience working with complex, cross-functional business domains where value is created through connected processes, data, and decision-making

• Experience with product-oriented delivery, demand management, business cases, prioritization, and benefits realization

• Analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity and competing priorities

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 45 professionals across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices. The team is solution-oriented and highly engaged in creating value across Orifarm. We have a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and flexibility, where helping each other succeed is a core principle.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.
